text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both holding steady with minimal daily moves, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 64 but has weakened over the past week, indicating confidence is cooling slightly despite prices remaining stable. BTC dominance at 59.6% with $58B in daily volume shows healthy participation across altcoins, though the lack of upside momentum in either major asset points to a market waiting for a clearer direction.
